caption: The last candle on a dinner table is blown out, and the table falls into darkness.

sa.check: The last candle on a dinner table is lit.

pc.expect: The warm light on the table disappears with the flame.
pc.fail: The table stays lit with the flame out; or goes dark before the flame; or another light appears.
The candle relights; or the room brightens with no source; or the light flickers back.

pc.expect: The flame goes out with the breath.
pc.fail: It goes out with no breath; or leans toward the breath; or stays lit through the puff.
It sinks; or hangs; or flows sideways with no draught.
A second candle appears; or it vanishes; or the flame becomes solid.

pc.expect: The table setting stays the same.
pc.fail: Items rearrange; or the cloth changes; or the candle changes.

note: The breath is the trigger; the person is not judged.
